# Vendors

The vendor side of Invoices covers everything you owe to suppliers. It starts with a vendor record. You then record the vendor's bill, pay it, and handle any refund for returned goods or overpayments. Each step builds on the one before it.

- [Manage vendors](./manage-vendors.md): create vendor records with contacts, addresses and bank accounts.
- [Create a bill](./create-bill.md): record what a vendor charges you and confirm it.
- [Create a refund](./create-refund.md): record a credit from a vendor for returns or overpayments.
- [Register a payment](./register-payment.md): send money to a vendor and settle open bills.
